bio: The Cock Inn is an award-winning country pub in Headley, near Epsom, surrounded by the stunning views of the Surrey Hills.  Indulge in one of Britain’s most loved traditions with Afternoon Tea in a contemporary, authentic pub environment, for all the family to enjoy.  A delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights await, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  Book your own private Afternoon Tea party in the characterful surroundings of the Derby Room or dine in the unique restaurant spaces or pub garden.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Saturday, 12pm to 5pm and advance booking is recommended.
